newsitem.title: USA: GM cuts Q2 production forecast by 27,000.
newsitem.headline: GM cuts Q2 production forecast by 27,000.

text.p: General Motors Corp on Wednesday said it cut its estimate of second-quarter North American production to 1,523,000 vehicles from 1,550,000 because of work stoppages in two assembly plants.

The company said its North American Operations produced 519,00 vehicles in April, including about 284,000 passenger cars and 235,000 trucks. That compares with North American production of 295,000 passenger cars and 215,000 trucks in April 1996.
Workers are staging strikes at GM's Oklahoma City car plant and at a plant in Pontiac, Michigan.
GM shares were down 5/8 at 58 early Wednesday afternoon.
